values.zh-CN: `Module.Basis ι 𝕂 V` 是 $V$ 的 **$\iota$-索引基的类型（结构）**，不是关于某个已有族的命题：其唯一字段是线性等价 $b.\mathrm{repr}:V\simeq_{\mathbb{K}}(\iota\to_0\mathbb{K})$，底层族由 $\mathord{\uparrow}b:\iota\to V$ 给出。写成三个显式参数 $\iota\ \mathbb{K}\ V$；族 $b$ 是结构元素，不是 `Module.Basis` 的第四个参数。（由“线性无关且张成”构造基请用 `Basis.mk`。）
values.en: `Module.Basis ι 𝕂 V` is the **type (structure) of $\iota$-indexed bases of $V$**, not a proposition about a pre-existing family: its single field is the linear equivalence $b.\mathrm{repr}:V\simeq_{\mathbb{K}}(\iota\to_0\mathbb{K})$, and its underlying family is $\mathord{\uparrow}b:\iota\to V$. It takes three explicit parameters $\iota\ \mathbb{K}\ V$; the family $b$ is an element of the structure, not a fourth argument. (Use `Basis.mk` to build a basis from a linearly independent spanning family.)
